thumbnail_texts: 달 때문이 아니었다 / 보름달 고양이 우다다
하룻밤 한 마리 / 보름달 고양이 폭주

image_concepts.A: 보름달 밤 거실을 질주하는 고양이 + 문틈에서 놀란 잠옷 차림 50대 집사
image_concepts.B: 침대에서 이불을 끌어안고 천장을 보는 50대 부부 + 캣타워에서 공중으로 뛰어오른 고양이 + 창의 보름달

meta.note: 2026-10-11 반실사 일러스트 전환 — 장면 유형 3가지 이상 (channels/science/config/thumbnail-strategy.json)

thumbnails.concept_ko: G 결정적 순간(교체 추천). 밤 거실을 전속력으로 달리던 고양이가 소파를 박차고 공중에 뜬 순간을 정지, 쿠션이 흩날리고 창밖에 커다란 보름달.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A cat frozen mid-leap in full sprint across a cozy living room at night, all four legs stretched, cushions and a sock flying in its wake, a huge full moon glowing through the big window behind. Warm orange lamp light inside, cool teal moonlight outside, dynamic and funny. Keep the lower 40% of the frame visually simple and slightly darker so large caption text can sit on it. No text, letters, numbers, arrows or logos anywhere in the image.

thumbnails.concept_ko: E+F. 고양이 눈동자 초근접 — 크게 열린 동공에 창밖 보름달이 비치는데, 눈 속 반사에는 달 옆에 벽시계 바늘(밤 9~11시 무렵)이 함께 비친다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. An extreme close-up of a cat's wide-open eye with a huge dark pupil; reflected in the glossy eye are a full moon in the window and, beside it, the hands of a round wall clock pointing late in the evening (no numbers). Teal and orange highlights, curious mysterious mood. Keep the lower 40% of the frame visually simple and slightly darker so large caption text can sit on it. No text, letters, numbers, arrows or logos anywhere in the image.

thumbnails.concept_ko: D 내려다보기 + A 단면. 지붕을 떼어 낸 아파트 단면을 비스듬히 위에서 — 층마다 집집마다 고양이들이 같은 시간에 거실을 질주하고, 하늘의 보름달은 작게.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A cutaway view of an apartment building seen from slightly above with the roof and front wall removed, revealing many living rooms on every floor, and in each one a different cat is sprinting across the room at the same moment, while a small full moon sits in the night sky above. Playful dollhouse-like composition, vivid colors. Keep the lower 40% of the frame visually simple and slightly darker so large caption text can sit on it. No text, letters, numbers, arrows or logos anywhere in the image.

thumbnails.concept_ko: F 원리 시각화. 낮 내내 잔 고양이 몸에 빛나는 에너지가 차오르다, 밤이 되자 빛의 궤적으로 터져 나와 거실 바닥·벽·캣타워를 따라 번개처럼 그린다.

thumbnails.concept_ko: B 시간 겹치기. 같은 거실을 좌우 반반 — 왼쪽은 밝은 낮 햇볕 아래 동그랗게 잠든 고양이, 오른쪽은 보름달 밤 같은 고양이가 커튼을 타고 질주.
